reviews.comment: Best professor I've had at TAMU by far!! I cannot recommend him enough.

Professor Lewis is the best history professor I've had. He is very passionate about the subject, and is unbiased in his lectures. Lectures are interesting bc he talks abt things beyond what is covered in usual courses. Attendance is not mandatory, but go to class bc the exams are lecture based. Small writing assignments and 2 bluebook exams

I took his HIST 105 class this spring, his teaching style is very immersive/easy to follow, he is enthusiastic on the subject & a fair grader.  the exams are blue-book (written) with plenty of prep, and a few smaller written assignments throughout the semester. plenty of time for preparation, attendance matters since exam is based off of lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It is easy to tell Prof. Lewis enjoys his subject and enjoys teaching it, and an enthusiastic professor is worth three dull professors.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Lewis is organized, approachable, and very supportive. I first had him as a TA and chose HIST 105 because of that experience. He brings the same helpful attitude to this class. The reading load is typical for a history course.
